summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy statement for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on June 8, 2026. Shareholders will vote on a share consolidation that combines existing Class A and Class B shares into fewer shares with higher par value (6-to-1 ratio). No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is proposed. The filing is a routine corporate action to adjust share structure, not a special situation.
